user.title: Configure Daikin One
user.description: Enter your Daikin One account credentials.

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed, please check your credentials and try again. Check the logs for more info.

group.title: Configure heat pump
group.description: Assign each indoor head to at most one outdoor heat pump.

emulation_settings.title: Configure emulated Heat/Cool
emulation_settings.description: Control how indoor heads coordinate heating and cooling on a shared outdoor heat pump.

data.convert_external_auto: Convert external Daikin Auto to emulated Heat/Cool

external_temperature.title: Configure an external temperature sensor
external_temperature.description: Select an indoor head to configure or disable adaptive external-temperature control.

external_temperature_head.title: External environmental control for {head}
external_temperature_head.description: Home Assistant will display the selected temperature and optional humidity sensors, and slowly adapt the physical Daikin setpoint. The Daikin controller may show a different target.

error.empty_members: Select at least one indoor head.
error.unknown_head: One or more selected heads are no longer available.
error.different_locations: All selected heads must be in the same Daikin location.
error.duplicate_head: An indoor head can belong to only one heat pump.
error.not_temperature_sensor: Select an available sensor with the temperature device class.
error.not_humidity_sensor: Select an available sensor with the humidity device class.

invalid_temperature_range.message: Emulated Heat/Cool requires both a low and high target, and the low target must be below the high target.

unassigned_heat_pump.message: Assign this indoor head to its outdoor heat pump before enabling emulated Heat/Cool.

heat_pump_grouping.title: Some Daikin heads are not assigned to a heat pump
heat_pump_grouping.description: The integration could not confidently determine the outdoor heat pump for: {heads}. Open the Daikin One integration options to assign these heads. Existing head controls continue to work normally.
